fields.why: The percentage of high-incidence counties (an outcome measured in each group) is reported and ranked for five county groups defined by racial/ethnic composition.
The five groups are counties with large Hispanic, Black, Asian, AI/AN or NH/PI populations; no other SPD is compared.
The article reports no tests or CIs; the groups are only ranked ("larger percentage"), so side by side, n_groups 5, is right.

brief_issues: The county groups overlap (a county can be 'large' for several groups), so they are not a partition; the brief does not say whether overlapping SPD-defined unit groups count as groupwise. Counting them, as A does, seems the useful reading.
